svg.title: The trial opens address and welfare corrections while validating Ananya's urgent reason.
svg.desc: At Rook Clinic, landmark evidence, migration dates and the signed clinical reason remain separate. Riju opens correction and appeal states, Cecil provisionally validates them, and Vale observes the full source trail.
